evidence_policy: Executable implementation, executable configuration, test assertions and observed local results only. Documentation, comments and docstrings are not treated as evidence.

criteria.scope: Standard ParamSpace versus MSQ Grid initialization for identical domains and requested candidate count k
criteria.protocol: Use existing configured parameter domains; time initialization separately from consumption over k and Cartesian size P. Report peak RSS, construction CPU time and actual rows retained. Keep enum order/value typing identical.
criteria.limitation: ParamSpace materializes O(k*d) values; MSQ Grid retains dimensions only initially. Comparing only initialization misses the legacy deletion bottleneck.
criteria.baseline_summary: Legacy ParamSpace materializes requested candidates; MSQ Grid avoids Cartesian materialization. Construction time and scaling were not measured.

criteria.criterion: Candidate generation throughput, novelty and exhaustion
criteria.scope: Standard generate(); MSQ Grid/Random/Sobol accepted candidate stream

measurement.unit: accepted candidates/s; raw draws/accepted; MiB/10^6 accepted

criteria.protocol: Measure full consumption for finite grids and fixed accepted k for sparse searches, with increasing occupancy k/P. Require exact candidate identity/order for deterministic same-strategy comparisons and track rejects/failures. Profile source hash/serialization/deletion time and seen-set memory.
criteria.limitation: Standard full consumption scans ~k² row positions; Grid has O(k) seen hashes; Random/Sobol impose 1000 retries. Uniformity/discrepancy criteria belong with methodological quality, not just speed.
criteria.baseline_summary: Legacy generate repeatedly filters remaining rows; MSQ retains accepted hashes and random/Sobol retries can exhaust. Enumeration throughput was not measured.

criteria.criterion: Cold process and first valid result latency
criteria.scope: Fresh source/pipeline construction through one semantically complete accepted output

measurement.state: Two scenarios, one fresh process per scenario; worker process wall includes warm measurements and output persistence, not first-result time

criteria.protocol: Use fresh processes, fixed dependencies and empty optional JIT caches. Separately record dependency import, Limen import, source read, preparation/model construction, first engine call and complete first output. Repeat independent process pairs with balanced order.
criteria.limitation: One cold result is descriptive. OS page cache and native library initialization must be reported; do not compare warm Limen kernels against competitor import/JIT time.
criteria.baseline_summary: First kernel calls: 0.910244 / 0.893429 ms. Adapter preparation: 102.716028 / 85.407332 ms. True process-to-first-valid-result latency remains unmeasured.

criteria.criterion: Complete research campaign throughput and stage attribution
criteria.scope: Specified split/model/search/recording contract from local source load through durable successful rounds

measurement.state: Single configured LightGBM factorized campaign pair only

criteria.protocol: Run identical accepted candidate sequence, model parameters, tolerances, folds and output retention. Record source/prep/fit/predict/backtest/metrics/persistence spans. Repeat independent campaigns; include strict failures separately from successes.
criteria.limitation: No universal native model workload equivalence: DLinear uses ridge SVD; optional backends delegate training. A faster run that produces less evidence or different predictions is not comparable.
criteria.baseline_summary: One 48-round pair: complete process 10.552471 s with fresh fitted preparation; 10.597700 s with reuse. General campaign throughput remains workload dependent.

criteria.scope: Eligible serial deterministic snapshot GridStrategy workloads with factorize=True

value.comparison: Both arms factorize=True; baseline disables only fitted-preparation reuse

measurement.state: One pair completed and output parity passed; no measured end-to-end gain

criteria.protocol: Run tests.benchmark_factorized_preparation once to validate mechanism on its configured fixture: 48 terminal rows, 24 model configurations, 2 fee values; compare cache-cleared fitted prep against fitted-prep reuse. Assert scientific digests equal at 12dp and instrument target/scaler/model fits. For statistical ranking, use additional preregistered independent paired campaigns.
criteria.limitation: Harness varies fitted-prep reuse only, with signal reuse enabled in both arms. 128-entry caches; narrow admissible models/targets/scalers; incompatible with parallel/event/walk-forward/pruning. One pair cannot establish stable speedup.
criteria.baseline_summary: Opt-in fitted reuse reduced target and scaler fits 24 to 1; model fits stayed 24. Outputs equal at 12 decimals; end-to-end ratio 0.995732, no demonstrated gain.

criteria.criterion: Indicator and feature kernel throughput by n and lookback
criteria.scope: SMA/EMA/RSI/CCI/linearreg/stochastic/Hilbert/line features/FFD, preserving full aligned arrays

measurement.unit: bars/s; ns/bar; slope versus n/w; peak MiB

criteria.protocol: Use recorded data prefixes only, fixed period/window/cadence, identical dtype and null/NaN behavior. Measure core and DataFrame wrapper separately. Assert timestamp/null-mask equality before numeric tolerances. Include large valid lookbacks and high feature width; report missing larger inputs.
criteria.limitation: Kernel complexity is mixed: O(n) array scans or Python recurrences, O(n*w) windows, O(n*H) line detection. Archived exact parity is continuity evidence, not independent formula correctness; TA-Lib helper alone drops NaN positions.
criteria.baseline_summary: Mixture of NumPy scans, Python recurrences, O(n*w) windows and pairwise line searches. No uniform kernel speed or scaling claim is supported.

criteria.criterion: Snapshot backtest latency under full execution parity
criteria.scope: Zero-cost close-to-close all-in long/flat buy_and_hold and sma_cross on supplied 1h fixture

native_snapshot.scope: backtest_snapshot validation, execution and all native bar metrics
backtest_snapshot validation, execution and all native bar metrics

measurement.unit: ms; bars/s; MiB; absolute equity error
measurement.state: Both scenarios verified, seven warm repeats retained

criteria.protocol: Run tests.benchmark_backtest_strategies with engines limen, strategies buy_and_hold sma_cross, repeats 7. Independent cash replay must match each equity sample, held bar and fill bar/side/price. Record engine-only, common-output and full snapshot timings separately, plus raw samples and source/code hashes.
criteria.limitation: Enforced refers to benchmark parity gate. No costed/event/barrier/short/funding ranking follows. Seven within-process calls yield a descriptive percentile, not a reliable tail SLA or independent-process uncertainty.
criteria.baseline_summary: Independent execution parity passed on two zero-cost snapshot cases. Warm kernel medians 0.375106 / 0.342447 ms; full snapshot 2.150025 / 1.699665 ms for 8,783 bars.

criteria.scope: Full account ledger and both-side forward labels, with sparse/dense timers and funding modes

measurement.unit: source events/s; ledger states/s; labels/s; bytes/state

criteria.protocol: Fix identical product, source availability, event tie order, fill precision, funding, barriers, exposure and outputs. Measure plan miss/hit separately, complete ledger materialization and optional label-only computation separately. Increase recorded partition prefixes and timer cadence within safe budgets; record actual event/state/candidate counts.
criteria.limitation: 8 plans/1M source-event cache does not bound timer ledger rows. Funding disables timer-span shortcut. Barrier-only forward labels may traverse long suffixes; funded candidate path recreates full ledger/source bindings.
criteria.baseline_summary: Event plans are bounded but timer ledgers can grow beyond plan limits. Forward trade labels can revisit long suffixes. Throughput and scaling remain unmeasured.

criteria.scope: Complete serial/parallel campaign including sources, caches, IPC, models, logs and ledgers

measurement.state: Single-process high-water only; process-tree scaling remains unmeasured

criteria.protocol: Sample process-tree RSS/PSS at stated interval; also record per-process high-water marks. Measure input/preparation/model/cache/output contributions where possible; distinguish byte-accounted cache size, live allocations and OS resident pages. Run matched datasets/workers without overlapping campaigns.
criteria.limitation: 128MiB computation-cache accounting is approximate and excludes transient computation; factorization caches are 128 entries; per-worker frames and full output histories grow. OS quotas may limit scaling independently of code.
criteria.baseline_summary: Snapshot process peak RSS 99.859375 / 100.234375 MiB; fitted-preparation pair 358.746094 / 362.976563 MiB. Process-tree and scale behavior remain unmeasured.

criteria.criterion: Parallel speedup, efficiency and load imbalance
criteria.scope: Eligible compiled CPU logreg/LightGBM rounds at workers 1,2,4,... with native_threads=1

measurement.unit: speedup S(w)=T1/Tw; efficiency S(w)/w; overlap; idle fraction

criteria.protocol: Use identical candidate order and full result/evidence parity; run homogeneous and naturally heterogeneous existing parameter workloads. Measure start/end intervals, parent commit time, barriers and process-tree memory; repeat independent balanced serial/parallel runs after startup controls.
criteria.limitation: Compiled CPU logreg/LightGBM only; factorization and post_processing rejected. FIFO pending[0] wait and worker-count pending capacity reduce heterogeneous utilization. Do not interpret the visible CPU affinity mask as guaranteed effective CPU quota.
criteria.baseline_summary: Restricted spawned CPU workers, bounded pending queue and ordered commitment. No speedup or utilization measurement; factorization is rejected in parallel mode.

criteria.criterion: Cache locality, hit cost and optimization coverage
criteria.scope: Computation, fitted-prep, prediction and EventPlan caches at cold/warm/eviction boundaries

measurement.unit: hit/miss ratio; recomputations; bytes; hit latency; workload support fraction

criteria.protocol: Count calls and actual retained bytes for repeated/unique keys below and above capacities using existing admissible domains. Mutate one consumed parameter/source at a time and require fresh-equivalent output. Measure hashing/copy overhead and revisit after eviction/resume. Publish a supported-workload matrix alongside timing.
criteria.limitation: Array keys require O(n) scan/bytes even on hits; failures/unsafe configurations bypass or reject reuse. Sources/functions admitted differ across factorization/parallel paths; a cache hit is not zero work and unknown coverage is not a pass.
criteria.baseline_summary: Serial reuse and narrow factorization caches exist. Factorized caches are capped at 128 entries, not bytes; workers do not share the parent reuse context.

criteria.scope: Full terminal prefix with recording variants and interrupted serial/parallel campaigns

measurement.unit: bytes/round; recording %wall; checkpoint ms; restart s; duplicated/lost rounds

criteria.protocol: Run same candidates and outputs under permitted recording profiles; measure serialization/hash/compression/write spans, physical bytes and dedup ratio. Interrupt after known durable checkpoints, resume and compare complete ordered terminal prefix and scientific outputs. Measure recovery versus history size; distinguish crash integrity from power-loss durability.
criteria.limitation: Dedup avoids repeated blob writes after serializing/hashing complete payload each round. CSV/results remain append/log work. Parallel resume loads committed payloads and rewrites/truncates prefix; fitted caches are cold. Individual blob size limits do not bound total run storage.
criteria.baseline_summary: Content-addressed recording avoids repeated disk blobs after serialization and hashing. Recovery validates/reconstructs history. Recording and restart scaling unmeasured.

criteria.scope: Point-in-time predictor values from native batch features; successive-prefix inference evaluated separately

measurement.status_detail: Failed independent probe on quantile_price_lines; no generic causal enforcement
measurement.evidence_detail: Independent reproduction on unchanged repository hourly fixture: first 192 versus 384 rows. Static code traces full-frame quantile threshold into historical end-event outputs.
measurement.comparison_measurement: 173/192 existing rows and all 5 retained quantile-feature columns changed for max_duration_hours=48, min_height_pct=.002, quantile_threshold=.70, include_research_only=False, rtol=atol=1e-12. Controls ordinary price_lines and quantile q=0: 0 changed rows.

criteria.protocol: For batch outputs claimed to represent historical predictor values, compare warmed prefixes against identical prefixes of future-extended input and point-in-time replay. Count differences and retain first divergence/tolerance. For latest-row-only inference, audit each prediction using only its available prefix.
criteria.limitation: Observed count describes this fixture/configuration only; it is not a population defect rate. Split-first processing does not remove this within-split lookahead. Shipped native LightGBM prep includes this feature. This is a failure of historical row values computed over complete evaluation batches. Using only the final row of successive available prefixes can be causal; that distinct path is not invalidated merely by calling the same function.
criteria.baseline_summary: Reproduced within-split lookahead in quantile_price_lines: 173 of 192 existing rows changed after extending to 384 rows. Both control configurations changed zero rows.

criteria.scope: Built-in MLManifest preparation versus arbitrary Python callbacks

measurement.status_detail: Implemented for built-in split-first and fitted preprocessing; caller-dependent for custom functions
measurement.evidence_detail: Static trace: raw splits precede bar/feature/target processing; target/scaler state fit only on train. Existing regression test perturbs last test fold and checks unchanged train/validation/selection.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure changed train/fitted-state/selection fields under held-out-only perturbation; report number of protected paths and tested configurations.

criteria.protocol: Freeze raw IDs and split bounds; alter only later held-out records using permitted actual observations; compare fitted objects and train/validation outputs before comparing score.
criteria.limitation: Pre-split selector sees complete admitted frame; arbitrary feature callables are not inspected for causality; custom architecture gets entire prepared dictionary.
criteria.baseline_summary: Native path splits raw input first and fits preprocessing on training data. Custom callbacks and a pre-split selector can see broader data; no universal isolation guarantee.

criteria.scope: Built-in forward targets and bound private trade labels

measurement.status_detail: Partial: split-local forward-label censoring and explicit trade-label availability; caller-supplied label semantics unverified
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: NextReturn and NextBarUp shift inside each split; Tradeline target nulls incomplete forward support. Direction/sizing uses private availability masks.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Count fitted rows with label-completion time at or after fit cutoff; count censored tail rows and report effective target horizon.

criteria.protocol: Retain source row IDs, decision time, label completion time and fit cutoff; audit every training row and terminal label separately.
criteria.limitation: No universal derivation of generic walk-forward purge from target horizon. Physical split-local generation already prevents these built-in targets from reading next split, so missing auto sizing is not itself demonstrated leakage.
criteria.baseline_summary: Built-in shifted labels are censored within splits; trade labels expose availability. Custom label horizons and availability require explicit verification.

criteria.scope: Configured walk-forward and ordinary ratio/date splitters

measurement.status_detail: Implemented explicit walk-forward geometry; stronger validation than default positional splitter
measurement.evidence_detail: Static code specifies anchored/rolling pools, train/test purge, validation purge and embargo after earlier tests; tests cover partition laws and malformed geometry.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Report raw and retained rows per fold, temporal overlap count, fit/validation/test gaps, embargoed IDs, and missing/duplicate timestamps.

criteria.protocol: Use identical raw date windows and retention policy across solutions; audit actual post-transform membership, not configuration alone.
criteria.limitation: Walk-forward requires sorted unique datetimes but does not enforce a universal regular cadence; raw row-count gaps are not automatically label/event-time gaps. Generic ratio split slices current row order.
criteria.baseline_summary: Walk-forward enforces ordered timestamps, fold geometry and configured purge/embargo. Gaps are not generally derived automatically from target horizons.

criteria.scope: Walk-forward ML and conditional direction/sizing

measurement.status_detail: Implemented locally with explicit availability purge
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: manifest deep copy and separate prep per WF fold; conditional stacking uses earlier signals whose long/short outcomes completed before block start; scaler/PCA refit per inner fold.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure distinct fit count, fitted-data support, surviving purged training rows, and OOF prediction coverage.

criteria.protocol: Hold fold IDs fixed; inspect each learned transform/model's training support and confirm OOF prediction never trained on current/future labels.
criteria.limitation: The underlying feature functions have already been applied to raw training rows; noncausal features remain possible. This is not a universal nested-validation protocol.
criteria.baseline_summary: Walk-forward refits copied manifests per fold. Conditional stacking uses earlier completed labels and refits its scaler/PCA inside inner folds.

criteria.scope: Built-in binary model calibration and event validation objective

measurement.status_detail: Validation-only selection implemented; independent calibration assessment remains external
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: FrozenEstimator calibration then threshold fitting on same validation sample. Objective returns validation execution utility with aligned causal source support.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure Brier score/log loss/ECE on untouched data, threshold stability, validation-versus-held-out utility gap and sample overlap between fitted stages.

criteria.protocol: Record separate train/calibration/threshold/evaluation sample IDs; use external final sample for performance comparison; include all-flat decision when optimizing economic objective.
criteria.limitation: Configured validation score is optimized on that same sample, so it is not an unbiased future-performance estimate. Objective currently permits specific binary built-ins and event execution only.
criteria.baseline_summary: Native calibration and threshold selection use validation data. Using the same validation sample for both is selection, not an independent performance estimate.

criteria.scope: Binary metrics, walk-forward summaries and execution return tapes

measurement.status_detail: Implemented with materially different conventions requiring normalization
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: AUC uses probabilities; no-negatives FPR/one-class AUC undefined. Numeric fold results are arithmetic means over finite values; thresholds not averaged.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Independently recompute metric/ledger maximum deviation; report pooled versus fold-average metrics, denominators, compounding and skipped nonfinite folds.

criteria.protocol: Pin probability/action semantics, return units, equity basis, periods, annualization, cost convention and fold aggregation before comparing.
criteria.limitation: Mean fold return is not concatenated compounded return; averaged counts are not pooled confusion counts. Finite-only averaging can hide unavailable fold metrics.
criteria.baseline_summary: Explicit metric implementations exist, but finite fold results are averaged arithmetically. balanced_metric means precision times square root of positive prediction rate.

criteria.scope: DSR/PBO and numerical correctness test surfaces

measurement.state: DSR/PBO formula evidence inspected; two snapshot execution-parity cases measured; empirical statistical calibration unmeasured
measurement.status_detail: Implemented formulas and local oracle/property checks; statistical calibration unproven
measurement.evidence_detail: Static formulas inspected; repository tests compare alternative DSR/PBO implementations and edge contracts; the selected local correctness campaign executed the relevant repository assertions.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure absolute/relative error against independently implemented oracle, edge-case rejection rate and tolerance; DSR test uses absolute tolerance 1e-14.

criteria.protocol: Separate algebraic formula agreement, optimized-versus-reference equality, and empirical probability calibration. Retain exact fixture hashes and dependency/runtime identity.
criteria.limitation: An alternate formula in the same repository is useful verification but not independent academic validation or empirical false-positive calibration.
criteria.baseline_summary: DSR/PBO formulas, edge checks and alternate in-repository formula assertions exist. Snapshot execution parity was independently measured. Numerical agreement does not establish inferential calibration or generalization.

criteria.scope: Experiment successful/failed round records

measurement.status_detail: Diagnostic warning frequency implemented; no automatic model exclusion
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: catches sklearn ConvergenceWarning category, records successful rounds as true/false and failures/missing evidence as null, then reports frequency.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure warnings/observed fits, failed/attempted fits, unavailable evidence, residual/condition measures and prediction variation across seeds/tolerances.

criteria.protocol: Carry warned successes into denominator; predeclare whether they are eligible; independently test selected result stability.
criteria.limitation: Absence of this warning is not proof of optimization convergence. Default warning evidence does not prevent downstream selection; user warning-as-error settings can abort.
criteria.baseline_summary: Convergence warnings and missing evidence are recorded. A warned model can remain successful/selected; diagnostic reporting is not an admission gate.

criteria.scope: Per-run returns/CSV and explicitly supplied experiment families

measurement.status_detail: Partial local inventory; no global complete search history
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: acceptance uses successful recorded return tracks; family reader reconciles CSV successes with recorded identities when available and counts retained failures.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure attempted/succeeded/failed/pruned/repeated/unrecorded counts; report inventory coverage as known fraction or unknown.

criteria.protocol: Predeclare full family before testing; append every attempted choice, cost, seed and evidence access, including failures; reconcile artifacts to terminal occurrences.
criteria.limitation: Failed attempts lack return tracks; supplied runs do not reveal deleted, crashed, pruned, external or undisclosed searches. Local count is not effective independent-trial count.
criteria.baseline_summary: Recorded local successes/failures and family identity checks support accounting. Unlogged, deleted, external or pruned search history is not globally recoverable.

criteria.scope: DSR and CSCV PBO reports

measurement.status_detail: Implemented conditional diagnostics, with important inferential limits
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: DSR uses per-bar moments and retained trial count; PBO enumerates equal-block complementary partitions; no serial-covariance adjustment or additional purge within PBO.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Report DSR/PBO, full trial pool, block count/bars, nominal combinations and unavailable reason. Default 2-block PBO has values 0, .5 or 1; supported 4/6/8 blocks have 6/20/70 nominal combinations.

criteria.protocol: Use synchronous returns and full declared search family; evaluate calibration under plausible dependence and adaptive selection separately; never substitute partition count for independent observations.
criteria.limitation: Statistics are not auto acceptance gates: report verdict false/null does not reject training or Sensor creation. No universal correction for adaptive search, regime dependence or hidden trials.
criteria.baseline_summary: DSR/PBO diagnostics are conditional on retained comparable tracks. Default two-block PBO has only three possible values; no serial-covariance correction in DSR.

criteria.scope: Family acceptance reports over supplied directories

measurement.status_detail: Implemented conservative grouping; snapshot joint PBO withheld
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: checks ordered timestamps, exact return-track equality and execution identity; refuses DSR for fragmented/incomplete family or singleton; preserves cross-directory alternatives.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure comparable groups, included/excluded tracks, verified evidence fraction, repeated evidence and exact sample mismatches.

criteria.protocol: Compare only identical ordered evaluation observations and return conventions; retain incompatible candidates and reasons, with no silent sample intersection.
criteria.limitation: Declared source identities are not independently verified; snapshot artifacts lack full OHLC execution identity so family PBO is unavailable; family selection itself can add multiplicity.
criteria.baseline_summary: Family diagnostics check aligned timestamps and execution identity and withhold unsupported conclusions. Snapshot joint PBO lacks full comparable source identity.

criteria.scope: Reserved local holdout for native dated binary Sensors/Cohorts

measurement.status_detail: Strong restricted protocol; incompatible with several principal research modes
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: admitted research prefix, frozen owned fitted state, pre-load durable attempt allocation, successive-prefix prediction, retained failures and exposure categories. Selected local tests exercise the protocol.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure frozen-state identity, source-access ordering, attempt count including started/failed, overlapping exposure and supported combination coverage.

criteria.protocol: Freeze selection/cost scenarios before final data access, allocate exposure durably, assess prefixes and retain every attempt; report initial-recorded/subsequent/unknown/post-release.
criteria.limitation: Only native exact LogRegBinary/LightGBMBinary inference with dated non-event data; reservation refuses custom SFDs, WF, parallel/factorized/resume/profile/bars/event/funding/callbacks. Repeated assessments are labelled, not prohibited; external exposure always unknown.
criteria.baseline_summary: Reserved holdout freezes supported fitted state and records attempts before loading data. Research and final-assessment compatibility is substantially restricted.

criteria.scope: Fixed strategy baselines, random actions and future use claims

measurement.status_detail: Baseline code available; comparative profitable generalization unknown
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: eight fixed read-only strategy definitions and a random-action reference; no profitability/generalization claim follows from correctness tests.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure paired out-of-sample utility/return difference under equal search and compute budget across preregistered assets/eras/venues, with dependence-aware uncertainty.

criteria.protocol: Require matched data, cost/execution, dates, risk budget and information availability for buy/hold, fixed rules, simple learned and candidate solutions; count all choices.
criteria.limitation: RandomBinary maps random actions to .9/.1 scores and uses global RNG, so it is not a calibrated probabilistic null. Correct implementation tests do not establish market edge.
criteria.baseline_summary: Executable strategy references exist. No external-comparator ranking, profitable generalization or cross-venue robustness was established in this review.

criteria.scope: Feature ablation, recorded evidence and parameter diagnostics

measurement.status_detail: Partial mechanisms implemented; robustness outcomes require measurement
measurement.evidence_detail: Static: seeded feature removal retained in round params; IID trial-row bootstrap correlation helper; path-specific fitted/recorded state supports replay.
measurement.comparison_measurement: Measure selection/prediction sensitivity to seeds, feature removals, splits and costs; successful reconstruction fraction and exact environment/data coverage.

criteria.protocol: Predeclare perturbations and budgets; preserve hashes/configs/runtime IDs; rerun chosen result with meaningful perturbations and report intervals with their dependence assumptions.
criteria.limitation: IID trial-row bootstrap intervals describe sampled trial correlations, not time-series strategy-return uncertainty or causal feature importance. Rich artifacts alone do not guarantee stable generalization.
criteria.baseline_summary: Seeded feature ablation and replay mechanisms exist. IID trial-row correlation bootstrap is not a dependence-aware market-return uncertainty estimate.

criteria.scope: YAML parse/validate/build_manifest/data-source execution when manifests are supplied by another party
criteria.protocol: Attempt direct disallowed names, namespace-prefix collisions, and traversal through attributes imported by allowed modules. Assert no prohibited callable can be resolved, admitted, bound or invoked. Identity checking is sufficient for dangerous callable probes.
criteria.limitation: Namespace-prefix matching followed by unrestricted getattr permits imported external objects. This is a consequential failure for hostile configuration, not evidence of an exposed remote deployment. Trusted Python callbacks remain trusted execution by design.
criteria.baseline_summary: Allowed-prefix traversal resolves limen.data.historical_data.os.system; modified manifest validates and binds that callable. Identity checked only; callable never invoked.

criteria.criterion: Input schema and numeric admission consistency
criteria.scope: Manifest validation versus public direct snapshot/event/sensor APIs
criteria.protocol: Run the same invalid-type, NaN/Inf, bound, missing-column, shape, duplicate-key and unknown-key corpus at every public equivalent route; report rejected/applicable count and any accepted case affecting numerical results. Treat explicitly modeled rebates separately.
criteria.limitation: Many Manifest checks are strong; direct snapshot helpers omit equivalent cost admission. Unknown YAML keys default to warnings in some blocks. A validation percentage must not hide route-specific failures.
criteria.baseline_summary: Native Manifest/event paths reject negative costs; direct snapshot accepts negative fee/slippage. Numeric admission guarantees vary by API.

criteria.scope: Feature generation, input parsing, event scheduling and worker runtime
criteria.protocol: Reject nonfinite numeric parameters before work; bound data-dependent work and allocations. For admitted small inputs, test adversarial parameter extremes under external memory/time limits and report maximum time/RSS and clean termination. Do not actually run an unbounded NaN case without containment.
criteria.limitation: NaN d or nonzero d with NaN threshold passes fractional_diff guards; weights append forever because the only comparison-based break stays false. Parser reads whole input. Storage/cache caps do not imply an experiment-wide RAM, disk or runtime quota. Static proof only; no harmful loop executed.
criteria.baseline_summary: Nonfinite fractional-difference parameters can create an unbounded weight loop (static proof). No general per-round deadline or process memory quota.

criteria.criterion: Data source network, archive and path boundaries
criteria.scope: HistoricalData CSV/Parquet/ZIP/local/HTTP(S) ingestion and dataset cache
criteria.protocol: With controlled local fixtures, verify schemes, address/path containment, redirects, bounded responses, decompression expansion, timeout propagation and cache revalidation. Report each route separately; do not probe external private endpoints.
criteria.limitation: General file and URL access is trusted-local functionality. A shared service would need external destination/path restrictions. Main downloads are bounded by a request timeout but read full content; the legacy Binance request has no explicit timeout. ZIP members are streamed to a parser rather than extracted, so conventional extract-path traversal is not observed. Cache hits trust filename identity.
criteria.baseline_summary: Main HTTP path has timeout/retries but no response/decompression size cap or general destination/path containment. Legacy Binance helper omits a request timeout.

criteria.scope: Committed manifest URI resolution, existing-content reuse, and family-evidence verification
criteria.protocol: Commit a copy of an existing valid manifest; mutate non-lineage content while retaining the filename and lineage ID. Every operation claiming that ID should recompute and reject mismatch. Separately test label tampering, malformed hash and prefix ambiguity.
criteria.limitation: URI/store paths check label rather than current content. Family evidence and runtime-generated metadata do recompute hashes, so the failure is not universal across provenance consumers. Hashes establish consistency, not authenticity against an owner able to rewrite all records.
criteria.baseline_summary: A manifest URI still resolves after scratch content changes while retaining its lineage label. Other execution/family paths do recompute content identity.

criteria.criterion: Recorded round corruption and reference integrity
criteria.scope: gzip-jsonl-v2 rounds and content-addressed market/signal blobs
criteria.protocol: Mutate CRC, gzip header, UTF-8, layout metadata, duplicate order, references, digest, missing blob, count and array alignment. Verify rejection and byte/mtime equality of persisted files after a failed resume; compare restored logical data with legacy storage.
criteria.limitation: Enforced within the inspected compressed recording contract. Per-record integrity and content hashes are not signatures, global file quotas, protection from symlink-owner attacks, or proof all consumer paths validate identical semantics. The cited corruption/reference tests ran in the selected local test campaign; this is not a full-suite claim.
criteria.baseline_summary: Round readers enforce digest/reference contracts and bounded members. Corruption tests verify rejection before stored bytes or modification times change.

criteria.criterion: Crash/restart consistency and durable commit frontier
criteria.scope: Experiment checkpoint and parallel resume over CSV, compressed records, blobs and audits
criteria.protocol: Interrupt at every write/commit boundary and restart. Require exact ordered committed-prefix equality, consistent parameters/predictions/ledgers and no mutation on malformed committed evidence. Distinguish process termination, write exceptions, OS crash, power loss and competing writers.
criteria.limitation: Extensive prefix validation and ordered commit design; ordinary checkpoint replacement is atomic at the file-name level but has no fsync, output files are separately written and no directory-wide writer lock is present. Power-loss/network-filesystem/multi-writer guarantees are unestablished.
criteria.baseline_summary: Atomic replacement and prefix validation aid restart. No fsync, experiment-directory writer lock or single transaction across all output files.

criteria.criterion: Parallel worker failure handling and bounded dispatch
criteria.scope: Admitted built-in compiled CPU logreg/lightgbm parallel rounds
criteria.protocol: Exercise normal, strict-rejection, raised exception, dead worker, failed initializer, SIGTERM at zero/final/outstanding phases. Report completed-prefix identity, orphan count, shutdown time and subsequent resumed equality.
criteria.limitation: Status applies to failure handling in admitted workloads; worker processes are not hostile-code isolation. The 0.1-second timeout polls for completion and does not limit a round duration. Built-in-only restrictions materially narrow supported workflows.
criteria.baseline_summary: Supported workers use native thread limits, bounded dispatch and failure cleanup. These are operational controls, not a security sandbox or production deadline.

criteria.criterion: Inference output validity and unavailable-signal behavior
criteria.scope: Python Sensor versus compiled Sensor handoff to downstream consumers
criteria.protocol: For each public Sensor route, test warm-up, preselection periods, missing/nonfinite features, malformed length/shape, nonfinite predictions/probabilities, out-of-range probabilities and thrown callbacks. Assert unavailable is distinguishable from numeric flat and test downstream treatment of unavailable signals.
criteria.limitation: Python callbacks/fitted objects remain ordinary trusted in-process code; declared training/selection cutoffs cannot prove no leakage. Compiled extraction passes numeric values without centralized finite/probability admission. No inference response alone creates a trading kill switch.
criteria.baseline_summary: PythonSensorBase validates finite outputs and probability bounds. Compiled scalar extraction lacks the same central guard; exceptions become unavailable results.

criteria.criterion: Execution chronology and source evidence admission
criteria.scope: Event-engine observations/signals/funding and their declared availability timestamps
criteria.protocol: Use identical recorded events with true availability times; test missing/duplicate IDs, reordered/overlapping bars, invalid OHLC, delayed availability, partition boundaries, source-content mutation and simultaneous events. Require no fill on evidence before its declared availability.
criteria.limitation: Validation establishes consistency of supplied metadata, not authenticity of external timestamps. Direct snapshot arrays have a different causality contract and permit zero lag. Fingerprints are not signed source attestations.
criteria.baseline_summary: Event execution validates chronology, positive finite prices, row order, nonoverlap and source bindings. Price-gap guard is optional.

criteria.criterion: Economic affordability, exposure and quantity constraints
criteria.scope: Event-engine target sizing, cash spot and linear perpetual accounting
criteria.protocol: Replay the same recorded price path under fixed costs, lot step, minimum notional and margins. Verify equity identities, net/gross/cost/funding reconciliation, post-cost affordability, reversal handling and rejection of out-of-contract exposure or spot borrowing.
criteria.limitation: max_exposure is checked for the requested target, not continuously rebalanced as prices move. Margin/equity breach aborts rather than simulating venue liquidation/bankruptcy. No market-depth participation or venue risk limits are established.
criteria.baseline_summary: Event policies enforce target exposure, affordability and lot rounding in their supported products. Maintenance breach raises; it is not a liquidation simulator.

criteria.criterion: Exit rules, gap treatment and execution uncertainty
criteria.scope: Event stop-loss/take-profit/time-stop logic and comparison with snapshot conventions

measurement.snapshot_terminal_convention: charge exit on last held row

criteria.protocol: Replay recorded OHLC windows with adverse opening gaps, both barriers touched, intrabar entry/resize, timeout and repeated signals. Align fill-price, costs, liquidity, terminal close and unavailable-signal conventions before comparing return/risks.
criteria.limitation: The event engine rejects some insufficient intrabar evidence and uses conservative precedence, but recorded OHLC cannot establish an exact intrabar path. Fill rules use fixed slippage and do not establish order-book queues, partial fill dynamics or guaranteed live stop execution.
criteria.baseline_summary: Stops take precedence on dual-touch bars and adverse gaps affect fills. Snapshot closes terminal holdings; event ledger can mark remaining inventory.

criteria.criterion: Protected holdout reservation and exposure accounting
criteria.scope: Supported local project-bound protected holdout mode
criteria.protocol: Reserve future intervals, attempt overlap/revision changes, concurrently run admitted research, try withdrawal after use, interrupt evaluation after attempt allocation and replay final assessment. Verify started/completed/failed history and explicit refusal of unsupported modes.
criteria.limitation: Protected mode rejects callbacks, resume, parallel, factorization, walk-forward, and event/funding execution. It records local research use, not secrecy from a machine owner, tamper-proof global history, or proof of no earlier external exposure.
criteria.baseline_summary: Local holdout ledger uses transactional attempts, admission leases and exposure categories; used reservations cannot simply be withdrawn. Owner secrecy is not enforced.

criteria.criterion: Executable supply-chain and security CI coverage
criteria.scope: Checked-in CI/release configuration and vulnerability audit implementation
criteria.protocol: Inspect executable workflows, exact tool/dependency pins, permissions, credential persistence, audit input set, expiry enforcement and package attestation generation. For a completed release separately verify hosted run status, resolved dependency advisories and provenance against released bytes.
criteria.limitation: The pip-audit gate reads only project.dependencies and resolves that set; it does not cover all optional research backends or every allowed version. Configured workflows and rulesets do not prove current successful execution or actual server-side enforcement.
criteria.baseline_summary: Checked-in CI pins dependencies/actions and configures security scans and attestations. Live CI state, branch protection and all optional dependency risks unverified.

criteria.criterion: Adversarial validation evidence and mutation coverage
criteria.scope: Property tests, fuzz harness, corruption tests and worker lifecycle tests
criteria.protocol: Publish an attack/failure-case matrix with expected outcomes and run counts. Include malicious attribute traversal, stale content hash, nonfinite resource parameters, archive expansion, concurrent writer and power-loss cases where applicable. Report reachable-code and mutation coverage separately from line coverage.
criteria.limitation: The fuzz harness does not compile/execute manifests. The declared property families cover permutation counts, parameter cardinality/determinism and splitter partitions. Existing namespace/lineage tests miss demonstrated boundary cases. Execution counts refer to the selected local test campaign; no broad security assurance follows from coverage alone.
criteria.baseline_summary: Property and mutation/corruption tests cover specific surfaces. Config fuzzing stops at parse/validate, so it does not test compiled execution boundaries.

protocol.rule: Executable implementation, executable configuration, test assertions and observed local results only. Documentation, comments and docstrings are not treated as evidence.
Compare a pinned solution + exact configuration + workload + resource envelope. Do not rank product names in isolation.

Compare indicator/feature kernels, candidate enumeration and fixed model fits separately. Output semantics, time alignment, NaN masks and parameter domains must match; numeric values must agree within preregistered tolerances.
Freeze prices, timestamps, signals, timing, costs, terminal settlement, position sizing, funding, stops and required outputs before timing.
Match preprocessing, target horizon, splits, search budget, selection objective, model settings, held-out protocol and persistence/evidence requirements.
Compare supported model state, causal context, output validation, exposure history and failure/unavailable behavior. Native support and adapter work are separate fields.

Record native, adapted, unsupported or outside declared scope. Unsupported required behavior is a coverage gap; it is not silently N/A. Never discard unsupported cases from the comparison denominator.
Record both commit IDs; dependency lock digest; Python/native libraries; immutable data bytes/hash; ordered timestamps; source semantics; seeds; thread/resource limits; code/config modifications.
Require aligned output masks, causal availability and execution parity within preregistered tolerances. A correctness failure remains visible; it cannot receive a favorable speed verdict.

For batch outputs representing historical predictors, run prefix-extension invariance and point-in-time replay at several real-data cutoffs after warmup. Record changed past rows, first divergence and magnitude. For latest-row-only inference, audit each prediction on its available prefix. Audit target availability and train-state support separately.
Separate process startup, first valid result, warm kernel, common-output work, full pipeline and persisted end-to-end work. Measure wall/CPU time, process-tree peak RSS and disk bytes.

Use independent fresh process pairs in balanced A/B and B/A order, then repeated warm calls within each. A starting design is 10 process pairs and 30 warm calls per process; these are review design choices, not guarantees of precision. Predeclare precision/power and expand only if needed.

Use process-pair-level uncertainty for speed ratios. Retain all samples, outliers, failures and order. Seven warm calls from one process are not seven independent machine replicates or reliable p95 evidence.
Use prefixes of the same recorded input across n, feature count, lookback, candidates, event cadence and worker count. Report actual admitted work and errors, not just requested work.

Inspect formulas and assumptions separately from numerical tests. Report trial history coverage, dependence treatment, effective sample/partition counts, OOS calibration and paired held-out utility where actually measured.

Separate trusted local researcher, third-party configuration/data, concurrent/crashing workers and capital-at-risk execution. A local safeguard is not automatically a hostile-input sandbox or broker control.
Checked on the specified admitted path or required by its execution contract. Not a universal guarantee across other APIs, configurations or external callbacks.
Implementation exists but requires opt-in and may have narrow compatibility. Its existence is separate from demonstrated benefit.
Some paths/properties are protected or implemented; identified gaps and compatibility limits remain.
A concrete counterexample or direct code path violates the stated scoped property. Record whether reproduced or statically established.
The scoped conclusion has not been established. A partial numeric observation may exist while a broader comparative conclusion remains unknown.
Property lies outside the explicitly agreed comparison scope. Give a reason. It must not conceal unsupported required capability.

Inspected = code traced; Tested = repository assertion executed locally; Reproduced = independent bounded counterexample; Measured = local benchmark/quantity; Unknown = no establishing evidence. Categories do not form a numerical quality score.

Only compute after comparable=Yes and both values exist. Lower-is-better ratio = Limen/candidate; higher-is-better ratio = candidate/Limen. Greater than one favors candidate. Zero denominators suppress ratios; errors and counts use candidate-minus-Limen deltas.
Use candidate better, equivalent within declared tolerance, Limen better, incomparable, or unknown. Preserve evidence and scope; never infer equivalence merely from nonsignificant difference.
Do not average speed, epistemic validity and safety failures. Present capability coverage and Pareto tradeoffs on common admitted workloads; disqualifying failures remain explicit.
Retain commands, environment, raw samples, failure logs, input and output hashes, candidate adapter diff and source permalinks. Rerun both sides in the same campaign after either revision changes.

One pinned revision, 82 targeted test modules and narrow real-fixture measurements. No full-suite/CI attestation, external competitor, production/broker exercise or empirical profitability conclusion.
